input.command:
cd /root/turn_residual_gating && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 -c "
import json, numpy as np
with open('runs/attention_steering/attention_steering_gen_n50_fixed.json') as f:
    fixed = json.load(f)
with open('runs/attention_steering/attention_steering_gen_n50.json') as f:
    orig = json.load(f)

n5_ref = {0.0: 0.028, 2.0: 0.062, 3.0: 0.441, 4.0: 0.598, 5.0: 0.680, 10.0: 0.959}

print('=== CORRECTED N=50 per-beta Summary ===')
print(f'{\"Beta\":>6} | {\"GAR_mean\":>9} | {\"GAR_std\":>8} | {\"PPL_mean\":>9} | {\"PPL_std\":>8} | {\"N_valid\":>7} | {\"N5_GAR\":>7} | {\"Old_GAR\":>9}')
print('-' * 90)

for key in ['beta_0.0','beta_2.0','beta_3.0','beta_4.0','beta_5.0','beta_10.0']:
    bd = fixed['results'][key]
    od = orig['results'][key]
    beta_num = float(key.replace('beta_',''))
    mid_gar = bd['mid_turns_avg_gar']
    mid_std = bd['mid_gar_std']
    ppl = bd['avg_ppl']
    ppls = bd.get('ppl_per_conversation',[])
    ppl_std = np.std(ppls) if ppls else 0
    n_valid = bd['n_valid_convs']
    n5 = n5_ref.get(beta_num, '-')
    old_gar = od['mid_turns_avg_gar']
    print(f'{beta_num:>6.1f} | {mid_gar:>9.6f} | {mid_std:>8.6f} | {ppl:>9.4f} | {ppl_std:>8.4f} | {n_valid:>7} | {n5:>7} | {old_gar:>9.6f}')

print()
print('=== Per-conv mid_gar stats ===')
for key in ['beta_0.0','beta_2.0','beta_3.0','beta_4.0','beta_5.0','beta_10.0']:
    bd = fixed['results'][key]
    pcm = bd.get('per_conv_mid_gar',[])
    if pcm:
        arr = np.array(pcm)
        print(f'{key}: n={len(pcm)}, mean={arr.mean():.6f}, std={arr.std():.6f}, min={arr.min():.6f}, max={arr.max():.6f}, median={np.median(arr):.6f}')
"
